title: Asghar asghar aaja mere dilbar
body:
HAI SUNA DASHT BETA
DAR JAAYE TUM NA TANHA
KYUN NEEND AAYE TUMKO
JALTI HUWI ZAMEEN PER
CHAE  MAAH MEIN MERI JAAN
KYA MOUT KA HAI SHMAAN
LILLAH TUM BATAO
KAISA JIYEGE MADAR
SUKHE LABOON PER TERE
QURBAAN AY MERE BACHE
KAISA YE MAA BOOHLAYE
WO DARD NAK MANZAR
PEHLU MERA NAHI THO
SOOGE KAISE BOLO
SUNI LAHAD MEIN BETA
UTH JAOOGE CHAMAKAR
TEER-E-SITAM KA LAGNA
GARDAN SE KHOON KA BEHNA
SARWAR NE KAISE DEKHA
DUMTODNA TADAP KAR
JAB MAIN WATAN KO JAOON
SUGHRA KO KYA BATAON
PUCHEGI TUM KO DUKHYA
MAIN KYA SUNAOON DILBAR
KYA MOUT KE YE DIN THAE
KOI BATAAYE MUJH SE
LOUTE HO RUN SE BETA
NAWAK LIYE GALE PER
SHAEH NE LAHU TUMHARA
CHECHRE PE APNE PEHRA
JAWOONGA HASHR ME AB
MAIN ISTARHA SE KEHKAR
KAISA SOHAIL LIKHE
KARBOBALA KA LAMHE
THA UMRBHAR YA NOUHA
BANU KE BAS LABOON PAR
